_doc: Every visual/audio asset the MATCHER game wears, where it came from, its license, and how to re-fetch or re-derive it. Re-derive everything: python3 tools/v033_matcher_art.py (art) + python3 tools/v033_sfx.py (sound). All sources are CC0; derivations inherit CC0.

sources.name: OpenGameArt - Gem Match 3 Set by Andrew Tidey (via the candyrush commit ec82c09 in this repo's history)
sources.used_for: Gem Vault skin (the default 5 gems) - gems/gem_0..4.png, 100px, trimmed+centered

sources.name: OpenGameArt - Candy Match 3 (via the candyrush commit ec82c09)
sources.used_for: Candy Shop skin - gems/candy_0..4.png; the 8-frame explosion sheet - fx/explosion_0..7.png

sources.name: OpenGameArt pops + Happy Adventure loop + Kenney interface sounds (via the candyrush commit ec82c09)
sources.used_for: pop_1..4 / pop_deep / m_swap / m_special / m_star / m_coin / m_boom / m_fail (sfx) and the happy theme matcher_happy.mp3 (music)

sources.name: Kenney - Particle Pack (fetched via OpenGameArt mirror)
sources.used_for: star_01/star_02 (the star sparkle + hypercube core + bomb fuse + the armed cursor), flame_01 (the flame gem ring center) - luminance-to-alpha converted

sources.name: OpenGameArt - animated butterfly (monarch photo-cut)
sources.used_for: modes/butterfly.png - the studio background flood-filled away, cropped square

sources.name: PIL-generated originals (tools/v033_matcher_art.py, deterministic)
sources.used_for: spider, ice_1..3, earth, gold/diamond/artifact, the 4 power icons, ov_flame/ov_star/ov_hyper overlays, bg_day/bg_peace skies, board cell + plate, the 5 mode cards, the thumbnail
